info.name: Docusign Reserved: Gets the shared item status for one or more users.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: count
params.description: Specifies maximum number of results included in the response. If no value is specified, this defaults to 1000.

params.name: folder_ids
params.description:
A comma separated list of folder IDs  for which the shared item
information is being requested.

If `item_type` is `folders`, at least one folder ID is required.

params.name: item_type
params.description:
Specifies the type of shared item being requested. The possible values are:

- `envelopes`: Get information about envelope sharing between users.
- `templates`: Get information about template sharing among users and groups.
- `folders`: Get information about folder sharing among users and groups.

params.name: search_text
params.description: This can be used to filter user names in the response. The wild-card '*' (asterisk) can be used around the string.

params.name: shared
params.description:
A comma-separated list of sharing filters that specifies which users appear in the response. 

- `not_shared`: The response contains users who do not share items of `item_type` with the current user.

- `shared_to`: The response contains users in `user_list` who are sharing items to current user.

- `shared_from`: The response contains users in `user_list` who are sharing items from the current user.

- `shared_to_and_from`: The response contains users in `user_list` who are sharing items to and sharing items from the current user.

If the current user does not have administrative privileges, only the `shared_to` option is valid.

params.name: start_position
params.description: If the number of responses is greater than `count`, the number of responses to skip. Typically this value is a multiple of `count`. Default: 0.

params.name: user_ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of user IDs for whom the shared item information is being requested.

items.docs:
Retrieves shared item status for one or more users and types of items.

Users with account administration privileges can retrieve shared access information for all account users. Users without account administrator privileges can only retrieve shared access information for themselves and the returned information is limited to the retrieving the status of all members of the account that are sharing their folders to the user. This is equivalent to setting the `shared` to `shared_from`.

info.name: Docusign Reserved: Sets the shared access information for users.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: item_type
params.description:
Specifies the type of shared item being requested. The possible values are:

- `envelopes`: Get information about envelope sharing between users.
- `templates`: Get information about template sharing among users and groups.
- `folders`: Get information about folder sharing among users and groups.

params.name: user_ids
params.description: A comma-separated list of user IDs whose shared item information is being set.

items.docs:
This sets the shared access status for one or more users or templates.

When setting user shared access, only users with account administration privileges can set shared access status for envelopes.

When setting template shared access, only users who own a template and have sharing permission or with account administration privileges can set shared access for templates.

Changes to the shared items status are not additive. The change always replaces the current status.
